about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Suji Halwa Semolina Pudding Cups
recipes.summary: Warm, glossy semolina pudding toasted in ghee with sultanas and almonds, served at Diwali and pujas.
steps: Warm the milk and water together in a small pan until steaming.
Toast the semolina in the ghee in a wide pan over medium heat for 6 minutes, stirring, until golden and fragrant.
Pour in the hot liquid carefully (it will spit), then add the sugar, sultanas and cinnamon and stir for 4 minutes until thick and the mix leaves the sides of the pan.
Spoon into six small cups and press down lightly.
Top with the almonds and serve warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 cup.
Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat with a splash of milk.

recipes.title: Crunchy Peanut Brittle
recipes.summary: Glassy golden sugar brittle packed with roasted peanuts, a sweet gift for the holidays.
steps: Line a tray with baking paper and have all the ingredients measured and ready.
Heat the sugar and water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat without stirring for 10 minutes until it turns a light amber colour.
Take off the heat and quickly stir in the peanuts, butter, salt and bicarbonate of soda; it will foam.
Pour onto the tray and spread thin with an oiled spoon, then cool completely.
Snap into about 16 pieces.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 pieces.
Safety: molten sugar reaches over 150°C and causes severe burns. Keep children and pets away, use a heavy pan, never touch or taste it hot, and soak the pan in hot water to clean.
Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Ghorayeba Eid Shortbread
recipes.summary: Pale, crumbly Middle Eastern shortbread that melts in the mouth, topped with a pistachio.
steps: Beat the butter and icing sugar for 5 minutes until very pale and fluffy.
Stir in the flour to a soft dough, wrap and chill.
Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional) and line two trays.
Roll into 16 balls, place on the trays and press a pistachio into each.
Bake for 15 minutes until set but still pale, with no colour. Cool on the trays.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 cookies. Plus 30 minutes chilling the dough.
Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week; they are fragile.

recipes.title: Firni Rice Milk Pudding Cups
recipes.summary: Silky ground rice and milk pudding set in cups with pistachios, served chilled at Eid.
steps: Whisk the rice flour with 1/2 cup of the cold milk until smooth.
Heat the remaining milk with the sugar in a saucepan until steaming, then whisk in the rice flour mix.
Stir constantly over medium heat for 10 minutes until the pudding thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Pour into four cups, sprinkle with the cinnamon and pistachios and chill until set.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 cup. Plus 3 hours chilling.
Keep in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Jam Thumbprint Christmas Cookies
recipes.summary: Buttery vanilla cookies with a pool of apricot jam, a simple holiday biscuit-tin favourite.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour to a soft dough and roll into 24 balls.
Place on the trays, press a deep thumbprint into each and fill with 1/2 tsp jam.
Bake for 15 minutes until the edges are pale gold. Cool on the trays for 10 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 cookies.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg yolk.
Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oat Crunch Easter Nests
recipes.summary: Crunchy toasted oat and chocolate nests, easy for kids to make at Easter.
steps: Line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases.
Toast the oats in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden. Melt the chocolate, butter and golden syrup in a bowl over a pan of barely simmering water, stirring until smooth, about 5 minutes.
Fold in the toasted oats until coated.
Spoon into the cases, press a hollow in the middle of each with the back of a spoon and chill until set.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 nest. Plus 1 hour chilling.
Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.

recipes.title: Orange Cinnamon Day of the Dead Muffins
recipes.summary: Soft orange and cinnamon muffins with a sugar crust, inspired by the flavours of pan de muerto.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon and orange zest.
Whisk the eggs, milk, orange juice and butter and stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Divide among the cases and sprinkle with the extra sugar.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 muffin.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Keep in an airtight container for 2 days or freeze for 1 month.

recipes.title: French Yoghurt Loaf Cake
recipes.summary: A simple, moist everyday cake measured from one pot of yoghurt, with lemon zest.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional). Grease and line a 900g loaf tin.
Whisk the yoghurt, sugar, eggs, oil and lemon zest until smooth.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then on a rack. Cut into 10 slices.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 slice.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Keeps wrapped for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Glazed Fairy Cakes
recipes.summary: Light little butter cakes with a thin glacé icing, a party-table classic.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a 12-hole bun tin with paper cases.
Beat the butter and sugar for 4 minutes until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time with a spoon of flour.
Fold in the remaining flour, milk and vanilla and divide among the cases.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden and springy. Cool on a rack.
Mix the icing sugar and water into a thin glaze and spoon over each cake. Leave to set for 20 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 cake.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Best within 2 days in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Coconut Jam Shortbread Squares
recipes.summary: A shortbread base with apricot jam and a chewy coconut topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional). Grease and line a 20cm square tin.
Beat the butter and icing sugar, stir in the flour to a dough and press into the tin. Bake for 15 minutes until pale gold.
Spread the jam over the warm base.
Whisk the eggs and caster sugar, stir in the coconut and spread over the jam.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden and set. Cool completely and cut into 16 squares.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 squares.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Store in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Greek Yoghurt Oat Muffins
recipes.summary: Moist apple and walnut muffins made with Greek yoghurt and oats for extra protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix the oats, flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Whisk the yoghurt, eggs, honey and oil, stir in the apple and combine with the dry mix until just mixed.
Fold through the walnuts, divide among the cases and bake for 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes in the tin.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 muffin.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days or freezes for 1 month.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Cheddar Savoury Loaf
recipes.summary: A moist loaf packed with grated zucchini, cheese and chives, lovely sliced and buttered.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Grease and line a 900g loaf tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, zucchini, cheese and chives.
Whisk the eggs, oil and milk and fold through until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 45 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then on a rack. Cut into 10 slices.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 slice.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days or freezes sliced for 1 month.

recipes.title: Olive and Rosemary Quick Loaf
recipes.summary: An easy yeast-free loaf with green olives, rosemary and a little cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Grease and line a 900g loaf tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder, olives, rosemary and cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk and olive oil and fold through until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then on a rack. Cut into 10 slices.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 slice.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Keeps wrapped for 3 days or freezes sliced for 1 month.

recipes.title: Chilli Cornbread Muffins
recipes.summary: Golden cornmeal muffins with sweetcorn, cheese and fresh chilli.

items: 1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix the polenta, flour, baking powder, salt, corn, cheese and chilli.
Whisk the eggs, milk and oil and stir through until just combined.
Divide among the cases and bake for 20 minutes until golden and firm.
Cool for 5 minutes in the tin.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 muffin.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Best the same day; keeps 2 days and freezes for 1 month.

recipes.title: Sundried Tomato and Basil Muffins
recipes.summary: Savoury muffins studded with sundried tomato, basil and cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, tomatoes, basil and cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk and oil and fold through until just combined.
Divide among the cases and bake for 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes in the tin.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 muffin.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Keeps in an airtight container for 2 days or freezes for 1 month.

recipes.title: Rough Puff Jam Pinwheels
recipes.summary: Flaky homemade rough puff swirled with apricot jam.
steps: Mix the flour and salt, stir in the cold butter cubes, then add the iced water to a rough dough. Roll to a rectangle, fold in thirds and repeat 3 times, chilling between folds.
Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional) and line a tray.
Roll the pastry to a 30 x 24cm rectangle, spread with the jam and roll up from the long side.
Cut into 12 slices, lay flat on the tray and brush with the milk.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden. Cool for 10 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 pinwheels. Plus about 45 minutes chilling between folds.
Best the day they are baked; keeps 2 days.

recipes.title: Mini Apple Strudel Rolls
recipes.summary: Flaky puff pastry rolls with a cinnamon, apple and sultana filling, sliced into bites.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional) and line a tray.
Mix the apple, sultanas, sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle each pastry sheet with the breadcrumbs, spread the apple mix along one edge and roll up tightly, sealing the edge with a little water.
Brush with the melted butter and cut each roll into 4 pieces.
Bake, cut-side up, for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden. Cool for 10 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 piece.
Best the day they are baked; keeps 2 days.

recipes.title: Chocolate Orange Truffles
recipes.summary: Rich dark chocolate ganache truffles with orange zest, rolled in cocoa.
steps: Heat the cream in a small pan until just steaming, about 2 minutes.
Pour over the chocolate and orange zest, wait 1 minute, then stir until smooth.
Chill until firm enough to scoop.
Roll into 20 balls with cool hands, coat in the cocoa and chill until firm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 truffles. Plus 2 hours chilling.
Keep in the fridge for up to 10 days.

recipes.title: Baked Ricotta Frittelle Bites
recipes.summary: Soft, lemony ricotta bites baked in a mini muffin tin instead of fried.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and grease a 24-hole mini muffin tin with the butter.
Beat the ricotta, eggs, sugar and lemon zest until smooth.
Stir in the flour and baking powder until just combined.
Spoon into the holes and bake for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cool for 5 minutes and dust with the icing sugar.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 4 bites.
Food safety: wash hands and the bench after handling raw egg.
Best warm; keep covered in the fridge for 2 days.
